actionResult.summary: 关闭 A1-RA-001：POSIX timeout command 在存在 timeout 时以 detached owned process group 启动；超时后对整个 process group 发送 SIGKILL，并在 bounded window 内用 process-group existence probe 确认 terminal。只有确认 whole owned group terminal 才返回 re-entry-safe timed-out-cancelled；无法确认、缺少 pgid 或 cancellation/confirmation error 均返回 outcome-unknown，继续复用现有 executionBlock fail-closed 语义。Windows taskkill whole-tree authority 保持不变。新增真实 descendant-survival regression，014 旧 direct-child-only kill 反事实下失败，修复后通过；未改变其他 A1 contract。
